outcome_named: Every migrated customer record preserved intact, not merely present in the target
decisive_assumption: Equal source and target row counts imply no record content was altered in transit
discriminating_observation: A field-level comparison of migrated records showing truncated names or shifted dates — as the 30-account spot check already shows — proves content was altered despite matching counts

outcome_named: Customers still active at day 90, not week-one signup volume
decisive_assumption: A 15% rise in week-one signups will carry through to customers retained at day 90
discriminating_observation: Day-90 retention for the new cohort staying flat while signups rise would show the proxy detached from the outcome

outcome_named: The integration working across all 140 tenants, including those on legacy authentication paths
decisive_assumption: One friendly pilot tenant exercised the conditions the other 139 tenants present
discriminating_observation: A tenant on a legacy authentication path failing the integration would show the pilot was unrepresentative of the rollout population

outcome_named: Report latency within the operator's target at the lower operating cost
decisive_assumption: Report queries repeat across users often enough for a shared read-through cache to hit
discriminating_observation: Query logs showing most report queries are unique per user would make the cache miss and favour nightly precomputation instead

outcome_named: A pricing change that raises revenue without driving away the existing small-team segment
decisive_assumption: Small-team demand is insensitive to the proposed tier boundary
discriminating_observation: Churn or downgrade signals from small teams in a trial cohort would show the boundary cuts the segment the change must keep

outcome_named: Reports reproducible from the existing audit log without building a second store
decisive_assumption: The existing log carries every field and write volume the new reports need
discriminating_observation: A report field missing from log records, or a replay failing to reproduce a report exactly, would show the log insufficient

outcome_named: No duplicate charges when a payment attempt times out and is then retried
decisive_assumption: Mocked gateway timeout responses behave like the gateway's real timeouts on the retry path
discriminating_observation: A duplicate charge in a test driven by a real or recorded gateway timeout would show the retry path unsafe despite the green mocked suite

outcome_named: Invoicing cost held within the operator's stated budget at current volume
decisive_assumption: Per-batch provider fees remain negligible at the operator's current invoicing volume
discriminating_observation: The provider's new fee schedule applied to current volume showing batch cost above the budget would show the settled choice's basis has changed
